prompt:
Production 2D GAME INVENTORY ITEM ICON ATLAS, original cozy island life sim, warm precise 16-bit PIXEL ART. Exactly 1536x1280 canvas, SIX columns FIVE rows, invisible 256x256 cells. Each cell contains ONE clearly recognizable isolated inventory item, logically32x32 pixels upscaled8x with hard square pixels. Not plants growing in soil: harvested portable inventory objects. Every item centered within its own cell, equal visual weight, max24-28 logical pixels wide/tall, generous transparent margin, no crossing cells. True transparent alpha background. Warm honey wood, cream, forest green, muted terracotta, golden highlights, rich readable outlines. Upper-left lighting, crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no vector shapes, no labels or numbers, no shadow outside icon. Every cell exact item:
ROW1: three bundled wooden logs with cut ends; three gray irregular stones; tied bundle of pale straw plant fibers; harvested white round radish with leafy top; harvested round layered lettuce head; tied bundle of golden wheat ears.
ROW2: small cream paper seed packet showing white radish picture; seed packet showing green lettuce picture; seed packet showing golden wheat picture; plump olive carp fish; slender silver minnow fish; small blue fish with red tail.
ROW3: slender spotted brown loach fish; one cream chicken egg; little open sack of mixed golden animal feed; warm ceramic bowl of white radish soup; small golden rustic bread loaf; tiny tree sapling with a wrapped root ball.
ROW4: harvested orange carrot with feathery top; two russet potatoes; ripe red tomato with green calyx; cream seed packet with orange carrot picture; cream seed packet with potato picture; cream seed packet with red tomato picture.
ROW5: ceramic bowl of fresh green salad with tomato slices; split baked potato on small cream plate; grilled carp on cream plate with tiny herb; ceramic bowl of orange carrot soup; charming brown leather farm backpack with green flap; small stack of golden round coins.
All 30 icons needed, exact reading-order layout, no extra props, background fully transparent. A commercially polished pixel farming RPG inventory sheet, beautifully recognizable at32px, no text, no watermark.
background_edit_prompt: Edit this exact 6-column 5-row game inventory atlas. REMOVE ONLY the pale white/gray/checkerboard backdrop from ALL 30 cells, so the space around each isolated object is TRUE alpha=0 transparent. Currently the background is incorrectly semi-transparent milky white and must be completely absent. Keep every object silhouette, color, detail, size, order, and exact cell position unchanged. Every icon itself must be fully opaque alpha=1 including white radish roots, white egg and cream seed bags/plates. Crisp pixel-art edges, no blur, no glow, no cast shadows. Do not introduce visible checkerboards or any background color. Preserve exact rectangular 6x5 atlas and all30objects; no labels or added details. This is production game asset background removal, not a mockup.
discarded_source: source/items-v1.png had a translucent pale backdrop; not used by the final game atlas.
processing: Godot nearest-neighbor resampling to 32px cells; binary alpha cutoff 0.6; centered within 28x28 safe bounds. Atlas 192x160, six columns and five rows. First 28 cells preserve World.NAMES IDs; last two are backpack and coins decorations.
ui_texture: Hand-authored pixel PNG nine-slice textures drawn in Python with Pillow. The 13 rebuildable inventory and HUD textures are produced by source/render-inventory-skins.py and imported by Godot. Inventory-scoped StyleBoxTexture Theme. No changed item data or multiplayer protocol.
